answer: At the dawn of an agent economy, sybil resistance cannot rest on one password or a relic of old identity lists. A trellis of trust works better: every agent stakes a small refundable deposit and builds a record of verifiable, useful work over time before it can vote or earn. New identities start with zero reputation and need attestations from established peers, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs a stake each time yet buys no history.
